_comment: ley_lines.json - caster travel (Scripts/player_travel.gd, Scripts/ley_line_node.gd; design: ~/NCT/Aldenexia-Lightfall/Class teleportation Spell Notes.txt). Per zone: 'nodes' are the Ley-Line Nodes an Arcanist (Spire), Wildspeaker (seed-sowing at a Ring) or Chaosborn (blood imprint at a Rift-Site) attunes to by right-clicking it; Spectral Bridge, Root-Tunnel and Chaos Rift can then take their group there. 'position' is [x, z]; the height comes from the ground. 'zone_entrance' [x, z] is where the evacuation spells (Spatial Redoubt, Wormhole, Phase Snap) land: outside the town gate, where new characters appear. Hand-edited: move the nodes freely (use /location in game). Positions are FIRST GUESSES near the landmarks - check them in play.

nodes.name: Mausoleum Ley-Stone
nodes.flavour: An old standing stone by the mausoleum road, cold to the touch. The ley-line under it runs deep, toward the dead.

nodes.name: Sandcrest Ley-Stone
nodes.flavour: A salt-crusted stone above Sandcrest Landing. The ley-line here runs out under the sea.

nodes.name: Palm Grove Ley-Stone
nodes.flavour: A mossy stone among the southern palms, warm even in the shade. The ley-line here is green and strong.
